subject: Upcoming Company Event: Save the Date!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual company retreat will be held on August 15-17 at the beautiful Lakeview Resort. This year's theme is 'Innovate & Elevate,' and we have planned various team-building activities, workshops, and networking opportunities. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the agenda and registration process. We look forward to a memorable and productive retreat together! Best regards, HR Team
